culture.tagline: Build the future of digital Africa
culture.mission: At Tesle, we're on a mission to empower African businesses with world-class digital solutions. We believe in the power of technology to transform industries, create opportunities, and drive economic growth across the continent.

values.title: Craft Over Speed
values.description: We ship fast but never at the expense of quality. Every line of code, every pixel, every word is intentional.

values.title: Radical Ownership
values.description: Every team member owns their work end-to-end. We trust each other to make decisions and take responsibility.

values.title: Continuous Learning
values.description: The digital landscape evolves daily. We invest in learning, share knowledge openly, and stay curious.

values.title: People First
values.description: Great work comes from happy, healthy people. We prioritise well-being, flexibility, and genuine connection.

values.title: African Excellence
values.description: We build for Africa and the world. Our solutions are designed with local context and global standards.

benefits.title: Remote-First
benefits.description: Work from anywhere in Ghana or across Africa. Our team spans cities and countries — we're built for async collaboration.

benefits.title: Competitive Compensation
benefits.description: We pay top-tier salaries in USD, plus equity options. Your compensation reflects the value you create.

benefits.title: Health & Wellness
benefits.description: Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your dependents, plus a wellness stipend for gym, therapy, or massage.

benefits.title: Learning Budget
benefits.description: Annual learning allowance for courses, conferences, books, and certifications. Your growth is our growth.

benefits.title: Flexible Time Off
benefits.description: Unlimited paid time off — we trust you to manage your energy. Minimum 20 days encouraged per year.

benefits.title: Annual Retreats
benefits.description: Every year we gather the whole team somewhere amazing. Past retreats: Cape Coast, Akosombo, and Accra.

benefits.title: Home Office Setup
benefits.description: One-time stipend for your dream home office — monitor, chair, desk, noise-cancelling headphones, whatever you need.

benefits.title: Equity Ownership
benefits.description: Every full-time team member receives stock options. When Tesle grows, you grow.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: We're looking for a senior software engineer to join our core engineering team. You'll architect and build scalable web applications, mentor junior engineers, and shape our technical direction.
responsibilities: Design and implement scalable full-stack web applications
Lead code reviews and architectural discussions
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers
Contribute to our open-source projects and internal tooling
Collaborate with design and product teams on feature development
requirements: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, and Node.js
Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Strong understanding of databases (PostgreSQL, Redis)
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
positions.benefits: All standard benefits plus a lead engineering stipend and conference budget.

positions.title: Product Designer
positions.description: We need a product designer who can take features from concept to polished UI. You'll work closely with engineers and stakeholders to create intuitive, beautiful experiences.
responsibilities: Design user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes
Conduct user research and usability testing
Maintain and evolve our design system
Collaborate with engineers during implementation
Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders
requirements: 3+ years of product design experience
Expert proficiency in Figma
Strong portfolio demonstrating UX thinking and visual craft
Experience with design systems and component libraries
Understanding of frontend development constraints
positions.benefits: All standard benefits plus a designer-specific tooling and resource budget.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Manager
positions.description: Lead our digital marketing practice and drive measurable results for our clients. You'll own strategy, execution, and reporting across paid, owned, and earned channels.
responsibilities: Develop and execute multi-channel marketing strategies
Manage paid advertising campaigns across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn
Lead content marketing and SEO initiatives
Analysing campaign performance and optimising for ROI
Presenting results and recommendations to clients
requirements: 4+ years of digital marketing experience
Proven track record managing significant ad budgets
Expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and analytics tools
Strong copywriting and content strategy skills
Experience in B2B and B2C marketing
positions.benefits: All standard benefits plus performance bonuses tied to campaign results.

positions.title: Photographer & Videographer
positions.description: Join our creative production team to shoot and edit compelling visual content for clients across commercial, corporate, and editorial projects.
responsibilities: Plan and execute photo and video shoots on location and in studio
Edit and retouch photos using Capture One and Photoshop
Edit video footage including colour grading and sound design
Maintain and organise equipment inventory
Collaborate with creative directors on project concepts
requirements: 3+ years of professional photography and videography experience
Proficiency with Sony and Canon camera systems
Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite and DaVinci Resolve
Drone pilot certification is a plus
Strong portfolio demonstrating range across commercial work
positions.benefits: All standard benefits plus equipment budget and travel opportunities.

positions.title: Junior Frontend Developer
positions.description: A great opportunity for a junior developer with 1-2 years of experience to grow their skills on real-world projects with mentorship from our senior team.
responsibilities: Build and maintain UI components in React and TypeScript
Write clean, well-documented code
Participate in code reviews and team stand-ups
Fix bugs and implement feature improvements
Learn from senior engineers through pair programming
requirements: 1+ years of frontend development experience
Proficiency in React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript
Familiarity with version control (Git)
Eagerness to learn and take feedback
Portfolio or GitHub profile showing your work
positions.benefits: All standard benefits plus dedicated mentorship and learning budget.

positions.title: Content Writer
positions.description: We're looking for a skilled content writer to produce blog posts, case studies, social media copy, and website content for Tesle and our clients.
responsibilities: Write and edit blog posts, articles, and thought leadership pieces
Develop case studies and white papers
Create social media copy and content calendars
Optimise content for SEO
Interview subject matter experts and synthesise insights
requirements: 2+ years of professional content writing experience
Excellent written English with a portfolio of published work
Understanding of SEO best practices
Ability to simplify complex technical topics
Experience with CMS platforms (WordPress, Contentful)
positions.benefits: Flexible contract terms with potential for full-time conversion.

internships.title: Software Engineering Intern
internships.description: Work alongside our engineering team on real projects. You'll gain hands-on experience with modern web technologies, agile development, and production systems.
requirements: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or related field
Familiarity with at least one programming language
Strong problem-solving skills
Available for a minimum of 3 months full-time

internships.title: Design Intern
internships.description: Learn the ropes of product design in a real agency environment. You'll support our design team on client projects and build your portfolio.
requirements: Currently pursuing a degree in Design, HCI, or related field
Basic proficiency in Figma
A design portfolio showing your potential
Available for a minimum of 3 months full-time

internships.title: Marketing Intern
internships.description: Get hands-on experience in digital marketing — from content creation and social media management to campaign analysis and reporting.
requirements: Currently pursuing a degree in Marketing or related field
Familiarity with social media platforms and trends
Strong writing skills
Available for a minimum of 3 months full-time
